name: tbPresumptiveBase
description: TB presumptive register: one row per TB presumptive encounter (tbPresumptiveEncounterObs), with the form's columns A to R -- serial number, CCC number, date, names, sex, age, national ID / UPI, address and phone, referred by, HIV result and date, sample type, x-ray, molecular / culture, microscopy, investigation outcome (DRTB, DSTB, No TB) and anti-TB start.

join.joinCondition: pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = t.patient_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

pa.person_address_id = (SELECT pa2.person_address_id FROM amrs.person_address pa2 WHERE pa2.person_id = t.patient_id AND pa2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pa2.preferred DESC, pa2.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.identifier_type IN (28, 50) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)
IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, t.enc_date) < 1, CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.birthdate, t.enc_date), ' Mo'), CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, t.enc_date), ' Yrs'))

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.identifier_type IN (5, 45, 47) ORDER BY FIELD(pi.identifier_type, 5, 45, 47), pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

CONCAT_WS(', ', (SELECT a.value FROM amrs.person_attribute a WHERE a.person_id = t.patient_id AND a.voided = 0 AND a.person_attribute_type_id = 31 ORDER BY a.person_attribute_id DESC LIMIT 1), pa.city_village, (SELECT a.value FROM amrs.person_attribute a WHERE a.person_id = t.patient_id AND a.voided = 0 AND a.person_attribute_type_id = 10 ORDER BY a.person_attribute_id DESC LIMIT 1))
NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', t.culture_text, IF(t.resistant_to IS NOT NULL, CONCAT('Resistant: ', t.resistant_to), NULL), DATE_FORMAT(t.culture_date, '%d/%m/%Y')), '')

CASE WHEN t.has_res = 1 THEN 'DRTB' WHEN t.smear_pos = 1 OR t.culture_pos = 1 OR t.has_tb_type = 1 THEN 'DSTB' WHEN t.smear_neg = 1 AND IFNULL(t.culture_pos, 0) = 0 AND (t.xray_code IS NULL OR t.xray_code IN ('N', 'ND')) THEN 'No TB' END
